# A package from the module cache names its source as module@version with
# -trimpath and without it. Its compile is the same both ways, so the flag is
# not in its key. A build with -trimpath and a test without it then share one
# object for the dependency.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

go get rsc.io/breaker@v1.0.0
go list -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' rsc.io/breaker
cp stdout plain.txt
go list -trimpath -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' rsc.io/breaker
cp stdout trimmed.txt
cmp plain.txt trimmed.txt

# The second compile was a cache hit.
go build -x -trimpath rsc.io/breaker
! stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

# The main module names its absolute directory without -trimpath, so the flag
# changes its compile and stays in its key.
go list -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' m
cp stdout main-plain.txt
go list -trimpath -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' m
cp stdout main-trimmed.txt
! cmp main-plain.txt main-trimmed.txt

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.20
-- m.go --
package m

import _ "rsc.io/breaker"
